title: Sunshine + Moonlight: game streaming without the lock-in

intro.headline: Your PC games, on every screen.
intro.subhead: An open-source host and client turn your gaming rig into your own cloud — 4K, low latency, no subscription, no NVIDIA required.

outro.headline: Own your game streaming.
outro.subhead: Sunshine on the PC, Moonlight on everything else. What's the first game you're playing from the couch?
